comments.value: this is SO MUCH better than the current one wow

Agree.

Also the profile layout literally looks like a direct clone of discord one - have some originality devs! The redesign here feels a lot better!

VOTE UP. This UI change feels like an update for better compatibility on mobile device but it looks awful on PC and VR. Less information, too many nonsense space wasted and make you to scroll up and down.
The "read more" button for bios bothered me specifically, and how the bio gets truncated after only 3 lines, this seems nice.

This is so much better. It feels like their version is just the same as the old layout but rearranged. Yours feels like you actually  went to a Staples, bought some organizers, shelves, and boxes and actually cleaned things up. Your version is SO much better. In fact, I like it so much I'd be willing to say I want it EXACTLY as you made it. I also really like how you made the bar to the right (with the world and groups) smaller it definitely looks a lot better when thinner and makes much more eye room for the profile itself which is the main point of clicking on someone anyways. I like the idea of having a scroll to read their bio rather than a "read more" button. In fact, less buttons please. The less I have to click on things, the better. This should help a lot for hand tracking as well as clicking on UI elements is a pain. A big area to click and drag/scroll is a lot easier. I like what you did with the languages as well making it a lot more front and center. Considering this game is VR "Chat" the chatting portion makes this change a lot better as knowing someones languages at a glance is honestly a significant, and pretty damn good change. Love this. Hope this becomes a reality.
I would prefer even denser but this is an improvement at least
I have added my own improvements on top of the improved edit. This is not edited well ofc but its something. Featured group banner is completely missing so I added a spot for it.
I like this so much more than the current Discord-style layout.
this, this feels so much cleaner. i hope this is considered
The entire layout feels like its trying to be very cross-platform compatible but doesn't have any aesthetic or style that stands out. It looks very bland and almost discord-like (boo).

details:
The new profiles contain less information available at first glance, things are all over the place (e.g. pronouns next to Verified 18+ next to represented group), elements appear big. I believe in having more things at glance, no layout shift (things moving other things), better grouped information, less empty space - better effectiveness and readability in short. 

I put together my slightly reimagined version of the design in the attachment that might better convey what could be improved.

2 screenshots - before and after
